---

Guiding question 2: Is the average number of times course content is
visited greater among students with low absenteeism than among students
with high absenteeism?

$$
Let $\mu_{LC}$ = mean number of times course content is visited by students with low absenteeism. Let $\mu_{HC}$ = mean number of times course content is visited by students with high absenteeism. $H_0$: $\mu_{LC} \le \mu_{HC}$ $H_A$: $\mu_{LC} > \mu_{HC}$
$$


```{r}
df = read.csv("dataset/xAPI-Edu-Data.csv")
df
summary_stats = favstats(VisITedResources ~ StudentAbsenceDays, data = df)
summary_stats
ggplot(df, aes(x = factor(StudentAbsenceDays, levels = c("Under-7", "Above-7")), 
               y = VisITedResources, 
               fill = StudentAbsenceDays)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(title = "Course Content Visits by Student Absenteeism Level",
       x = "Absence Days",
       y = "Number of Visits to Course Content") +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Under-7" = "skyblue", "Above-7" = "orange")) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

```

```{r}
#split the data in low and high absence 
low_absenteeism = subset(df, StudentAbsenceDays == "Under-7")$VisITedResources
high_absenteeism = subset(df, StudentAbsenceDays == "Above-7")$VisITedResources

t_test_results = t.test(x = low_absenteeism, 
                        y = high_absenteeism, 
                        alternative = "greater", 
                        var.equal = FALSE)
t_test_results
```
